notes: *the oblation of the people* writes two *the*s; rule 29's arthrous case gives the one standing before *people* to the rectum's article and the one before *oblation* to the construct as a supplied determiner. Nothing is fronted.
כַּאֲשֶׁר fuses to *as* under rule 30 and is headed on the preposition, which is what the English *as* renders; heading on the relative was the competing reading.
כִּפֶּר → *make atonement* heads on the complement under rule 44, and קְרַב → *Draw near* keeps its head on the verb, the particle naming nothing alone.
All three object markers are unrepresented under rule 16, the ASV writing each object bare.
